summary: Built comprehensive integration-heavy test suite (Option B) covering link creation, redirect prefixing, auth protection, IDOR owner scoping, retention enforcement, URL validation bypass rejections, and worker idempotency.
evidence: 63/63 automated tests passing in pytest including 7 dedicated integration tests in apps/api/tests/test_module09_integration_suite.py.
Verified link creation: authenticated POST /links returns HTTP 201 with generated code and short_url.
Verified redirect: GET /r/{code} returns HTTP 302 with target Location header while system /health remains unaffected.
Verified auth protection: unauthenticated requests to protected endpoints strictly return HTTP 401.
Verified IDOR owner scoping: cross-tenant read/update/delete returns HTTP 404 (decisions.module_04.not_owner_status).
Verified retention enforcement: purge_old_clicks deletes records older than 30 days while retaining recent records.
Verified URL validation: rejects bypass vectors (javascript, data, unescaped schemes) with HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Verified async worker idempotency: calling process_click_event_record twice with identical event_id results in 1 inserted row and 1 deduplicated no-op.
All live verification probes passing in progress/evidence/module-09/build-evidence.txt with strict database isolation assertion.
